arm-A.title: Trinity's capture turns into a massacre
arm-A.summary: The raid on Room 303 begins as a textbook arrest and ends as a slaughter. Trinity submits to the squad's guns, but the instant the Big Cop reaches to cuff her she moves faster than they can follow and kills them one after another until she is the only one left standing, dropping a single 'Shit' as her only crack. Outside, the Agents arrive and strip the Lieutenant of his authority, and Smith informs him that the two units he trusted to be winning are already dead.
arm-A.action: The squad breaches Room 303 and forces Trinity to submit; the Big Cop steps in to cuff her and she turns the arrest into a close-quarters killing, ending with every officer dead. Simultaneously the Agents displace the Lieutenant outside and Smith reveals the units are already gone.

affects_outside.enables: The massacre proves to the Agents that ordinary law enforcement cannot contain Trinity, clearing the way for them to take the operation over and pursue her themselves — Smith's move into the hotel is the direct institutional consequence of the squad's failure.
affects_outside.blocks_or_costs: It costs the police their entire unit and their authority over the case; the Lieutenant's territorial gamble is spent, and the ordinary world's belief that this is a catchable 'little girl' is destroyed along with the officers who held it.
affects_outside.off_screen_reactor: The wider police operation and whatever command sent the Agents now have to answer for a wiped-out unit and a target that has proven beyond their control — the deaths Smith reports are the first ripple of a pursuit that will no longer be theirs to run.

arm-A.turns_on: The pivot is Trinity's body: the instant the Big Cop's cuff reaches her, her slow surrender inverts into inhuman speed, and the arrest becomes the massacre. Everything the squad believed — that contact meant control — dies in that reach.

arm-B.title: Trinity's capture turns into a massacre
arm-B.summary: Four cops breach Room 303 in the fire-gutted Heart O' The City Hotel and take Trinity at gunpoint; she raises her hands behind her head in apparent surrender. Outside, the Lieutenant brags that his units are bringing down 'one little girl' while Agent Smith tells him those men are already dead. Back inside, the moment the Big Cop reaches with the cuffs, Trinity moves inhumanly fast: she shatters his nose and hurls him across the room into another cop, killing them both, snatches a gun, twists it, and fires. When the gunfire ends, one flashlight rocks slowly to a stop over the dead and Trinity is the only one standing, unhurt. She lets slip a single 'Shit.' Outside, Smith turns and heads into the hotel on Smith's nod, leaving the defiant, disbelieving Lieutenant behind.
arm-B.action: The raid on Room 303 inverts in a single instant. Trinity's surrender in the room is a choice, not a defeat: she lets the squad believe the arrest is routine, then converts the first physical contact — the Big Cop's cuffs reaching for her — into the opening of her violence. She breaks the perimeter, turns the cops' own momentum and weapons against them, and by the end has wiped out the armed, outnumbering squad, standing alone over the dead as the victor rather than the captive. Outside the hotel, the Agents already know the outcome and move to seize the operation while the Lieutenant, still believing his men are succeeding, rages against them in denial.

arm-A.title: Trinity's capture turns into a massacre
arm-A.summary: Four cops breach Room 303 in the fire-gutted Heart O' The City Hotel and take Trinity at gunpoint; she raises her hands behind her head in apparent surrender. Outside, the Lieutenant brags that his units are bringing down 'one little girl' while Agent Smith tells him those men are already dead. Back inside, the moment the Big Cop reaches with the cuffs, Trinity moves inhumanly fast: she shatters his nose and hurls him across the room into another cop, killing them both, snatches a gun, twists it, and fires. When the gunfire ends, one flashlight rocks slowly to a stop over the dead and Trinity is the only one standing, unhurt. She lets slip a single 'Shit.' Outside, Smith turns and heads into the hotel on Smith's nod, leaving the defiant, disbelieving Lieutenant behind.
arm-A.action: The raid on Room 303 inverts in a single instant. Trinity's surrender in the room is a choice, not a defeat: she lets the squad believe the arrest is routine, then converts the first physical contact — the Big Cop's cuffs reaching for her — into the opening of her violence. She breaks the perimeter, turns the cops' own momentum and weapons against them, and by the end has wiped out the armed, outnumbering squad, standing alone over the dead as the victor rather than the captive. Outside the hotel, the Agents already know the outcome and move to seize the operation while the Lieutenant, still believing his men are succeeding, rages against them in denial.

arm-A.title: Trinity's escape across the rooftops to the phone
arm-A.summary: Morpheus confirms Trinity's hotel hardline is cut and directs her to a phone at Wells and Lake. She runs the building's exterior to the street — hall, fire escape, roof, across the rooftops, and down through a window into a back stairwell — while the Agents pursue and match her. She reaches a ringing booth on the street and is gone before a garbage truck crushes it, so the Agents are left with wreckage and no body, but with the crew's next target named as Neo.
arm-A.action: After Morpheus confirms the hotel hardline is cut and directs her to a phone at Wells and Lake, Trinity bursts into the hall into Agent Brown and his police unit and flees she plummets through the shattered glass and onto the fire escape. Finding Agent Smith waiting in the alley below, she climbs to the roof and runs the rooftops, clearing a 40-foot gap the cops cannot follow while Agent Brown duplicates the leap with the same unnatural grace. She launches from the roof's edge toward a lit window, dives, crashes through glass into a back stairwell, and — finding only wind where she expects Brown — gets to her feet despite her injuries. On the street she races a U-turning garbage truck to a ringing phone booth, answers it, and is gone before the truck pulverizes the booth; the Agents inspect the wreckage with no body, but leave with the next target named as Neo.

arm-B.title: Trinity's escape across the rooftops to the phone
arm-B.summary: Morpheus tells Trinity the traced hardline is cut and she must reach the Wells and Lake phone instead. She bolts through a hall where Agent Brown appears and out a broken window onto the fire escape, only to find Agent Smith waiting in the alley below, forcing her up onto the roof. She runs the rooftops with cold grace while the cops flounder and Brown duplicates her leap across the 40-foot gap, then she dives through a lit window, crashes down a stairwell, and races the garbage truck to the booth. She answers the Wells and Lake phone and is gone before the truck destroys the booth. On the street, the Agents convert the loss into a colder victory: the informant is real and they now have the next target's name.
arm-B.action: Trinity loses her hardline exit and is driven across the rooftops to the Wells and Lake phone, escaping the Agents only because the machine's hunt has already shifted to a new target.

arm-A.summary: Morpheus tells Trinity the traced hardline is cut and she must reach the Wells and Lake phone instead. She bolts through a hall where Agent Brown appears and out a broken window onto the fire escape, only to find Agent Smith waiting in the alley below, forcing her up onto the roof. She runs the rooftops with cold grace while the cops flounder and Brown duplicates her leap across the 40-foot gap, then she dives through a lit window, crashes down a stairwell, and races the garbage truck to the booth. She answers the Wells and Lake phone and is gone before the truck destroys the booth. On the street, the Agents convert the loss into a colder victory: the informant is real and they now have the next target's name.

arm-B.title: Trinity's escape across the rooftops to the phone
arm-B.summary: Morpheus confirms Trinity's hotel hardline is cut and directs her to a phone at Wells and Lake. She runs the building's exterior to the street — hall, fire escape, roof, across the rooftops, and down through a window into a back stairwell — while the Agents pursue and match her. She reaches a ringing booth on the street and is gone before a garbage truck crushes it, so the Agents are left with wreckage and no body, but with the crew's next target named as Neo.
arm-B.action: After Morpheus confirms the hotel hardline is cut and directs her to a phone at Wells and Lake, Trinity bursts into the hall into Agent Brown and his police unit and flees she plummets through the shattered glass and onto the fire escape. Finding Agent Smith waiting in the alley below, she climbs to the roof and runs the rooftops, clearing a 40-foot gap the cops cannot follow while Agent Brown duplicates the leap with the same unnatural grace. She launches from the roof's edge toward a lit window, dives, crashes through glass into a back stairwell, and — finding only wind where she expects Brown — gets to her feet despite her injuries. On the street she races a U-turning garbage truck to a ringing phone booth, answers it, and is gone before the truck pulverizes the booth; the Agents inspect the wreckage with no body, but leave with the next target named as Neo.
